The Great Wall is visible from LEO only under very favorable conditions (low sun angle, snow contrast, no haze) and is not obviously easier to spot than many other human structures — some astronauts have photographed it, others have said it's harder to see than they expected relative to things like highways, airports, dams, or city grids.
